given: You approved the pull request on Monday at 10:00. The author pushed two commits on Tuesday. A base-branch merge landed on Wednesday. There is no later verdict. What should you look at?
must: approved but the code changed since
pass: This is approved but the code changed since the verdict. It is shown first. The Wednesday merge from the base branch does not count.
why: An approval attached to unread code is still mergeable and is shown first.
